verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers core WooCommerce features (payments, shipping labels, REST API, taxes, product variations) but contains no mention of multi-location inventory tracking, per-warehouse stock levels, or warehouse-based fulfillment routing — WooCommerce core inventory management is single-stock-level per product/variation. Missing for 10: any documentation of multi-warehouse/location stock tracking, location-based stock adjustments, or fulfillment routing logic.
